description: [Meta · free] Preview what a tool call will cost before running it. Pass tool_name plus the params you intend to call it with: variable-cost tools (get_post_set_engagers, map_constellation, enrich_people, linkedin_profile_posts, linkedin_company_posts, linkedin_post_reactions, linkedin_post_comments, run_stream_now) are priced from those params with the same formula the tool's balance pre-check uses. Returns { tool_name, cost_max, cost_typical?, unit, explanation, cost (= cost_max), balance, sufficient, known_tool }. cost_max is the worst case the balance must cover; cost_typical is what such a call usually costs (you are charged only for what is actually fetched). Also accepts a stream type (external_profile, company, topic, person_interests, hiring_signals, ad_watch) to preview its per-page run price (stream_cost). Free.

params.description: The params you plan to call the tool with. Examples: get_post_set_engagers { profile_id | collection_id | post_ids / post_urls, max_posts, max_pages_per_post, max_enrich, freshness_days } (with a scope it counts the posts that actually need a sync); map_constellation { max_targets }; enrich_people { person_ids, linkedin_urls, max_credits }; linkedin_profile_posts / linkedin_company_posts { max_posts }; linkedin_post_reactions / linkedin_post_comments { max_pages }; run_stream_now { stream_id, max_pages }.

tool_name.description: MCP tool name (e.g. 'get_post_set_engagers') or stream type (e.g. 'external_profile')

name: get_cost_estimate
